result.description: A fictional 27-inch creative display built for color-critical illustration, photo editing, and boutique studio work. It features a 2560x1440 MiniLED panel, 99% DCI-P3 coverage, 600 nits peak brightness, and a USB-C hub with 90W power delivery. The stand supports height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustment, making it suited to compact desks and mixed-use workspaces.
